name: uvdesk
description: UVDesk - An Open Source Helpdesk. UVDesk is an open source helpdesk solution that can be self-hosted, allowing you to manage family and friends' IT problems with a helpdesk like you would in an IT career. If you are wanting to use UVDesk for business use, you should support the developers by contacting them on their website and looking at pricing options. IMPORTANT: Read the setup guide before first run: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/untraceablez/Unraid-apps/main/uvdesk-read-first.md Website: https://www.uvdesk.com/en/ Original Project GitHub: https://github.com/uvdesk/community-skeleton/ Template GitHub: https://github.com/untraceablez/uvdesk-Unraid/ Docker Image:https://hub.docker.com/r/untraceablez/uvdesk/

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Host port mapped to the container's Apache (port 80). Browse here to reach UVdesk and run the web installer.

variables.name: External DB Host
variables.description: Address of your external MySQL/MariaDB (unRAID host IP, or a DB container's name if on the same custom Docker network). REFERENCE ONLY - type this into the installer's Database step; the container does not consume it.

variables.name: External DB Port
variables.description: Port of your external MySQL/MariaDB. Reference only - entered in the web installer, not consumed by the container.

variables.name: App Environment
variables.description: Leave it as dev for the install process, after install completes, swap to prod.

variables.name: Site URL
variables.description: The FQDN for your site, e.g. helpdesk.mysite.com. You'll need to forward your IP:PORT combination through your reverse proxy or tunnel for it to work.
